newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil deputies fail to vote on civil service bill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil deputies fail to vote on civil service bill.

text.p: A lower-house committee in Brazil's Congress on Tuesday failed to vote on the text of civil service legislation that would end job guarantees of public-sector workers.
A meeting of the committee was suspended when a full session of the Chamber of Deputies began.
Further meetings of the committee have been scheduled for Wednesday, though officials were unable to confirm whether they would take place.
The government hopes the civil service reform will enable federal, state and municipal authorities to dismiss civil servants whose jobs are currently protected.
